event.description: Tie the ninth-closest positional scalar groups
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,110 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 12 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0069, the eighth positional tie at 2,110 parameters and unchanged 99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0034. The closest current groups have representatives 70 and 183, values 0.0132020144 and 0.0132044218, differing by 2.407e-6; representative 183 already denotes the accepted 183/282 group. Hypothesis: unioning coordinate 70 into that group with a multiplicity-weighted mean preserves qualification and yields 2,109 parameters. This is more informative than any other untested union because it is the current minimum-distortion group merge after eight accepted reductions.
